description.zh:
录像生命周期，即录像文件在云端保存的天数。

> 您需要设置录像生命周期大于0，才可使用视频服务提供的其他录像功能。录像生命周期最大可设置为3650天。
description.en:
The recording lifecycle, which specifies the number of days that recording files are retained in the cloud.

> You must set the recording lifecycle to a value greater than 0 to use other recording features provided by LinkVisual. The maximum recording lifecycle is 3650 days.

description.zh:
IPC设备的设备名称。
您可以在物联网平台控制台的**设备**页查看**DeviceName**。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**ProductKey**。
></notice>
description.en:
The name of the IPC device.
You can view the **DeviceName** on the **Devices** page in the IoT Platform console.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **ProductKey**.
></notice>.

description.zh:
IPC设备的设备ID。物联网平台为该设备颁发的ID，设备的唯一标识符。可调用物联网平台[QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~)查询。

><notice> 如果传入该参数，则无需传入**ProductKey**和**DeviceName**。**IotId**作为设备唯一标识符，和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入**IotId**和**ProductKey**与**DeviceName**的组合，则以**IotId**为准。
></notice>
description.en:
The device ID of the IPC device. This is the ID issued by IoT Platform for the device and serves as the unique identifier of the device. You can call [QueryDeviceDetail](~~69594~~) of IoT Platform to query the ID.

><notice> If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify **ProductKey** or **DeviceName**. IotId is the globally unique identifier of a device and corresponds to a combination of **ProductKey** and **DeviceName** on a one-to-one basis. If you specify **IotId** together with **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, **IotId** takes precedence.
></notice>.

description.zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的**实例概览**页面，查看当前实例的**ID**。

><notice>
- 若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
- 若无<props="intl"><ph>**实例概览**页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

></notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见[实例概述](~~356505~~)。
description.en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.

><notice>
- If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If no<props="intl"><ph> **Overview** page or</ph></props> ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

description.zh:
IPC设备所属产品的ProductKey。
您可以在物联网平台控制台**产品**页查看或调用[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
><notice> 如果传入该参数，需同时传入**DeviceName**。
></notice>
description.en:
The ProductKey of the product to which the IPC device belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the **Products** page in the IoT Platform console or call [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) to view the information about all products under the current account.
><notice> If you specify this parameter, you must also specify **DeviceName**.
></notice>.

title.zh: 设置设备录像在云上的存储生命周期
title.en: Set the cloud storage lifecycle for device recordings
